Another name for [Animate](Animate), with the same parameters and behavior. The original Blitz3D has no command of this name. It is the name PureBasic and FreeBasic use, and the original sample `MAK-sfx` uses it where Blitz3D has `Animate`, so it is accepted here as an alias.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
box = CreateCube()
PositionEntity box, 0, 0, 5
AnimateEntity box, 1, 0.5
While Not KeyHit(1)
	UpdateWorld
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Wend
```

@param entity      The entity to animate.
@param mode        0 stop, 1 loop, 2 ping-pong, 3 one-shot. Defaults to 1.
@param speed       Playback speed, negative for backwards. Defaults to 1.
@param sequence    Number of the sequence to play. Defaults to 0.
@param transition  Frames over which to blend from the current pose. Defaults to 0.
